summary: Axalta Coating Systems Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its merger agreement with Akzo Nobel N.V. The amendment restructures the transaction to add a second merger subsidiary for tax integration purposes, with two sequential mergers ultimately leaving Axalta as a wholly owned subsidiary of AkzoNobel. The original merger was announced November 18, 2025; in this amendment, the consideration and per-share price are not restated, and terms such as premium, break fee, and expected close are not provided. The independent directors will be jointly nominated post-closing. Watch for regulatory and shareholder approvals expected later in 2026.
